40021481.author: पदार्थः
40021481.content: अभिषिक्ते having been consecrated, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थे when Rama, धर्मेण righteously, विदितात्मनि whose soul was known, व्यतीता passed, या which, निशा night, पूर्वा first, पौराणाम् of the citizens, हर्षवर्धिनी increasing joy.

40021481.author: Translation
40021481.content: When Rama, whose soul was known for righteousness, had been consecrated, the first night, which increased the joy of the citizens, passed.

40021482.author: पदार्थः
40021482.content: तस्याम् in that, रजन्याम् night, व्युष्टायाम् having dawned, प्रातः in the morning, नृपतिबोधकाः awakeners of the king, वन्दिनः bards, समुपातिष्ठन् stood near, सौम्याः gentle, नृपतिवेश्मनि in the king's palace.

40021482.author: Translation
40021482.content: As that night dawned, in the morning, gentle bards, who were the awakeners of the king, stood near the king's palace.

40021483.author: पदार्थः
40021483.content: ते they, रक्तकण्ठिनः with melodious voices, सर्वे all, किन्नराः Kinnaras, इव like, शिक्षिताः trained, तुष्टुवुः praised, नृपतिम् the king, वीरम् the hero, यथावत् appropriately, सम्प्रहर्षिणः greatly rejoicing.

40021483.author: Translation
40021483.content: All of them, with melodious voices, trained like Kinnaras, greatly rejoicing, duly praised the heroic king.

40021484.author: पदार्थः
40021484.content: वीर O hero, सौम्य O gentle one, प्रबुध्यस्व wake up, कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन O enhancer of Kausalya's joy, जगत् the world, हि indeed, सर्वम् all, स्वपिति sleeps, त्वयि when you, सुप्ते are asleep, नराधिप O king of men.

40021484.author: Translation
40021484.content: O heroic and gentle king, who increases Kausalya's joy, please awaken, for indeed, when you sleep, the entire world sleeps.

40021485.author: पदार्थः
40021485.content: विक्रमः valor, ते your, यथा like, विष्णोः of Vishnu, रूपम् form/beauty, च and, एव indeed, अश्विनोः of the Ashvins, इव like, बुद्ध्या in intellect, बृहस्पतेः of Brihaspati, तुल्यः equal, प्रजापतिसमः equal to Prajapati, हि indeed, असि you are.

40021485.author: Translation
40021485.content: Your valor is like that of Vishnu, your beauty is like that of the Ashvins, you are equal to Brihaspati in intellect, and indeed, you are like Prajapati himself.

40021486.author: पदार्थः
40021486.content: क्षमा forgiveness/patience, ते your, पृथिवीतुल्या equal to the earth, तेजसा in splendor, भास्करोपमः comparable to the sun, वेगः speed, ते your, वायुना to the wind, तुल्यः equal, गाम्भीर्यम् depth, उदधेः of the ocean, इव like.

40021486.author: Translation
40021486.content: Your patience is like that of the earth, your splendor is comparable to the sun, your speed is equal to the wind, and your depth is like that of the ocean.

40021487.author: पदार्थः
40021487.content: अप्रकम्प्यः unshakable, यथा like, स्थाणुः a pillar, चन्द्रे in the moon, सौम्यत्वम् gentleness, ईदृशम् such, न not, ईदृशाः such, पार्थिवाः kings, पूर्वम् before, भवितारः will be, नराधिप O king of men.

40021487.author: Translation
40021487.content: You are unshakable like a pillar, and possess such gentleness as found in the moon; O king of men, there have been no such kings before, nor will there be in the future.

40021488.author: पदार्थः
40021488.content: यथा as, त्वम् you, अतिदुर्धर्षः extremely formidable, धर्मनित्यः always righteous, प्रजाहितः devoted to the welfare of the subjects, न not, त्वाम् you, जहाति abandons, कीर्तिः fame, च and, लक्ष्मीः prosperity, च and, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men.

40021488.author: Translation
40021488.content: As you are extremely formidable, always righteous, and devoted to the welfare of your subjects, O best among men, neither fame nor prosperity ever abandons you.

40021489.author: पदार्थः
40021489.content: श्रीश्च prosperity and, धर्मश्च righteousness and, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha (Rama), त्वयि in you, नित्यं always, प्रतिष्ठितौ are established. एताश्च these and, अन्याश्च other, मधुरा sweet (praises), वन्दिभिः by bards, परिकीर्तिताः were proclaimed.

40021489.author: Translation
40021489.content: O Rama, prosperity and righteousness are eternally established in you, and these and other sweet praises were sung by the bards.

40021490.author: पदार्थः
40021490.content: सूताश्च and charioteers/bards, संस्तवैः with praises, दिव्यैः divine, बोधयन्ति awakened, स्म (past tense indicator), राघवम् Rama. स्तुतिभिः with praises, स्तूयमानाभिः being sung, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke, राघवः Rama.

40021490.author: Translation
40021490.content: The bards, with their divine praises, awakened Rama, and Rama awoke to the sound of these eulogies being sung.

40021491.author: पदार्थः
40021491.content: स He, तत् that, विहाय having left, शयनं bed, पाण्डराच्छादनास्तृतम् covered with white sheets, उत्तस्थौ rose up, नागशयनात् from the serpent-bed, हरिः Vishnu, नारायणो Narayana, यथा as.

40021491.author: Translation
40021491.content: He rose from that bed, which was covered with white sheets, just as Lord Narayana (Vishnu) rises from his serpent-bed.

40021492.author: पदार्थः
40021492.content: तम् Him, उत्थितं risen, महात्मानं the great-souled one, प्रह्वाः humble, प्राञ्जलयो with folded hands, नराः men, सलिलं water, भाजनैः with vessels, शुभ्रैः pure/clean, उपतस्थुः approached/offered, सहस्रशः by thousands.

40021492.author: Translation
40021492.content: Thousands of humble men, with folded hands, approached the risen great-souled Rama, offering him water in pure vessels.

40021493.author: पदार्थः
40021493.content: कृतोदकशुचिः having performed ablutions and become pure, भूत्वा having become, काले at the proper time, हुतहुताशनः having offered oblations to the fire, देवागारं to the temple, जगाम went, आशु quickly, पुण्यम् sacred, इक्ष्वाकुसेवितम् frequented by the Ikshvakus.

40021493.author: Translation
40021493.content: Having purified himself with ablutions and offered oblations to the sacred fire at the appropriate time, he quickly went to the holy temple, which was traditionally frequented by the Ikshvaku kings.

40021494.author: पदार्थः
40021494.content: तत्र there, देवान् gods, पितॄन् ancestors, विप्रान् Brahmins, अर्चयित्वा having worshipped, यथाविधि according to custom, बाह्यकक्षान्तरम् to the outer chamber, रामः Rama, निर्जगाम emerged, जनैः by people, वृतः surrounded.

40021494.author: Translation
40021494.content: After duly worshipping the gods, ancestors, and Brahmins, Rama emerged into the outer chamber, surrounded by many people.

40021495.author: पदार्थः
40021495.content: उपतस्थुः approached, महात्मानः great-souled ones, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सपुरोहिताः with their priests, वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः headed by Vasishtha, सर्वे all, दीप्यमानाः shining, इव like, अग्नयः fires.

40021495.author: Translation
40021495.content: All the great-souled ministers, along with their priests and headed by Vasishtha, approached Rama, shining brightly like fires.

40021496.author: पदार्थः
40021496.content: क्षत्रियाः Kshatriyas, च and, महात्मानः great-souled ones, नानाजनपदेश्वराः rulers of various countries, रामस्य of Rama, उपाविशन् sat near, पार्श्वे at the side, शक्रस्य of Indra, इव like, यथा just as, अमराः immortals.

40021496.author: Translation
40021496.content: Great-souled Kshatriyas and rulers from various regions sat by Rama's side, just as the immortals sit by Indra.

40021497.author: पदार्थः
40021497.content: भरतः Bharata, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, अत्र there, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, च and, महायशाः highly renowned, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे attended, हृष्टाः delighted, वेदाः Vedas, त्रयः three, इव like, अध्वरम् a sacrifice.

40021497.author: Translation
40021497.content: There, the highly renowned Bharata, Lakshmana, and Shatrughna attended upon Rama with delight, just as the three Vedas attend upon a sacrifice.

40021498.author: पदार्थः
40021498.content: याताः came, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, किङ्कराः servants, मुदिताननाः with joyful faces, मुदिताः joyful ones, नाम indeed, पार्श्वस्थाः standing by the side, बहवः many, समुपाविशन् sat down together.

40021498.author: Translation
40021498.content: Many servants with joyful faces came with folded hands and, indeed joyful, sat down by his side.

40021499.author: पदार्थः
40021499.content: वानराः monkeys, च and, महावीर्याः greatly valorous, विंशतिः twenty, कामरूपिणः assuming any form at will, सुग्रीवप्रमुखाः led by Sugriva, महौजसः greatly powerful, रामम् Rama, उपासन्ते serve.

40021499.author: Translation
40021499.content: Twenty greatly valorous and powerful monkeys, led by Sugriva, who can assume any form at will, serve Rama.

40021500.author: पदार्थः
40021500.content: विभीषणः Vibhishana, च and, चतुर्भिः by four, रक्षोभिः rakshasas, परिवारितः surrounded, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Rama), उपासते serve, धनेशम् the lord of wealth (Kubera), गुह्यकाः Guhyakas, इव like.

40021500.author: Translation
40021500.content: And Vibhishana, surrounded by four rakshasas, serves the great-souled Rama, just as Guhyakas serve Kubera, the lord of wealth.

40021501.author: पदार्थः
40021501.content: तथा similarly, निगमवृद्धाः elders of the guilds/cities, च and, ये who, कुलीनाः of noble birth, च and, मानवाः men, विचक्षणाः wise, शिरसा with their heads, आवन्द्य having bowed down, राजानम् the king (Rama), उपासन्ते serve.

40021501.author: Translation
40021501.content: Similarly, the wise elders of the guilds and noble-born men serve the king, Rama, having bowed down with their heads.

40021502.author: पदार्थः
40021502.content: तथा thus, राजा the king (Rama), श्रीमद्भिः by glorious, ऋषिभिः sages, वृतः surrounded, च and, महावीर्यैः greatly valorous, राजभिः kings, च and, वानरैः monkeys, च and, सराक्षसैः with rakshasas, परिवृतः surrounded.

40021502.author: Translation
40021502.content: Thus, the king Rama is surrounded by glorious sages, greatly valorous kings, monkeys, and rakshasas.

40021503.author: पदार्थः
40021503.content: यथा just as, देवेश्वरः the lord of gods (Indra), नित्यम् always, ऋषिभिः by sages, समुपास्यते is served, तेन by that, रूपेण in form/splendor, अधिकः superior, सहस्राक्षात् than the thousand-eyed one (Indra), विरोचते shines.

40021503.author: Translation
40021503.content: Just as the lord of gods, Indra, is always served by sages, Rama shines with a splendor superior to that of the thousand-eyed Indra.

40021504.author: पदार्थः
40021504.content: तेषां of them, समुपविष्टानां who were seated, तास्ताः those various, सुमधुराः very sweet, कथाः stories, कथ्यन्ते are narrated, धर्मसंयुक्ताः endowed with righteousness, पुराणज्ञैः by those who know the Puranas, महात्मभिः by great souls,

40021504.author: Translation
40021504.content: To those who were seated, various very sweet stories imbued with righteousness were narrated by great souls who were learned in the Puranas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 37 ।। Thus ends the thirty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
